messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: synth/probe-eu-1 — 5xx rate 4.8% over 2m (threshold 3%). Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PI12345
pagerduty: Alert created (SRE-Canaries escalation). Auto-page to on-call.
emma: acked alert on PD :white_check_mark: taking first look
emma: quick health check — prod frontend metrics show normal 200 traffic, only canary pool failing. sending probe logs now.
emma: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:21:05Z] probe-eu-1 -> https://probe-api.eu.internal/health 502 
[2026-03-15T12:21:06Z] probe-eu-1 -> https://probe-api.eu.internal/health 502 
[2026-03-15T12:21:10Z] probe-eu-1 -> https://probe-api.eu.internal/health 504 
```
samir: thanks — looks like gateway 5xx from target prober instance group, not the edge LB. any recent deploys to prober?
jessica: no deploys to prober in last 24h from release board. could be autoscaler or new config rollout.
emma: checking infra console — noticed a config push to prober-fanout-service 30m ago: concurrency cap bumped from 50 -> 200.
emma: hypothesis: fanout surge is overloading upstream probe-api and causing 5xx.
samir: makes sense. mitigation options: 1) revert cap, 2) throttle prober at caller, 3) temporarily mute PD for this alert group while we investigate. prefer quick throttle to reduce customer risk.
emma: rolling throttle now: kubectl -n prober set env deploy/prober PROBER_MAX_FANOUT=60 --record
ops-bot: Command accepted: rolling update started for deploy/prober — 3 pods restarting sequentially
pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by emma.
jessica: any sign of customer impact? SLO dashboards?
emma: SLO: no change in customer error rate across services, requests to production APIs stable. only synthetic probe failures. tagging severity: low customer impact but high noise.
samir: taking over from emma for handoff in ~10m. will keep watch and follow up. emma: handing off — wrote runbook steps in ticket INC-2026-778.
emma: notes in ticket: reproduce steps, logs, config diff:
```diff
- PROBER_MAX_FANOUT=50
+ PROBER_MAX_FANOUT=200
```
samir: saw error spikes drop after throttle started. plotting 5xx rate now.
ops-bot: Canary 5xx rate (probe-eu-1): 00:00 -> 4.8%, 00:05 -> 3.1%, 00:12 -> 0.9%
samir: looks like mitigation working. will keep throttled until we validate upstream capacity. next steps: revert config rollout or add backpressure to probe-api.
jessica: agree — set follow-up task to capacity test upstream and add circuit-breaker. tagging product for impact review.
pagerduty: Alert resolved (manual resolution) by samir.
incident-bot: Incident closed: synth/probe-eu-1 recovered below threshold for 10m. Root cause prelim: aggressive fanout config pushed to prober overloaded probe-api causing transient 5xx.
emma: quick postmortem draft in INC-2026-778, assigning owners: samir (mitigation & follow-up), jessica (prod changes & capacity), emma (runbook update).
samir: leaving detailed timeline in ticket. moving to monitoring watch for 1h, will hand back to oncall rotation after that. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jessica: thanks all — glad no customer-visible errors. recommend we add automated guard to block fanout increases >2x without canary. :thumbsup:
emma: adding that to runbook now.
ops-bot: PD note: escalation policy updated to suppress repeated synth alerts for 15m after first mitigation ack to reduce noise — temporary until permanent guard in place.
samir: closing thread, will reopen if we see regressions.
